# THE NIGHT UNC art

Related: `guara-game-design` (roster, mechanics), `yeral-hints` (Yeral dialogue).

## Style
Painted pixel art with dark outlines, glowing accents, slightly gritty. Do not use coarse blocky placeholders.

Yeral the Spoilerman palette (level, UI, projectiles, traps):
- Forest green `#17251a` to `#29442a` (coat, walls, banners); near-black `#080d0a`
- Toxic lime `#70ed18` / `#9cff22` / `#68f51c` (glow, orbs, live traps, screens)
- Gold `#d99a28` (trim, warning telegraphs); brown `#513321` (boots, wood)

## Source sheets (`art/sheets/`, ignored by Godot via `art/.gdignore`)
- `yeral_sheet.png` - Yeral poses: idle_0/1, run, announce, point, swing, cast, taunt, summon, dash, plus the orb.
- `robot_sheet.png` - robot minion: idle, run, warn, shoot, hurt, dead frames, plus bolt and boom FX.
- `level_sheet.png` - lair props: banners, lamps, desk/crown screen/hologram, crates, platforms, spikes, terminal, vat, etc.
- `glizzy_sheet.png` - supplied 1536x1024 Yeral-to-hotdog transformation, bun combat poses, collapse, and condiment effects.
- `spoiler_gotham_sheet.png` - Gotham City "Spoiler Man theme" background spritesheet (opaque, dark green smoke backdrop, S emblems): skyline painting, clouds/moon, modular towers, rooftop details, bridges, walkways/platforms, street props, windows, ground/base layers, beam/atmosphere effects.
- `neon_lawyer_sheet.png`, `money_minion_sheet.png` - unaltered supplied stage-two boss and ground/helicopter minion sheets.
- `plaza_stage.png` (2172x724), `pub_stage.png` (1983x793), `factory_stage.png` (2172x724) - complete current stage-two room paintings. Earlier `waterfront_sheet.png` and `lucky_irish_sheet.png` remain archived originals, not current backgrounds.
- `corrupt_capital_sheet.png` - supplied transparent 1536x1024 stage-two bannered platforms, money/capital props, office details and hanging decorations.
- `medalla_powerups_sheet.png` - user-supplied transparent pickup sheet with medalla cans and coins; source kept unchanged.
- `football_sergeant_sheet.png` - user-supplied 1536x1024 Football Sergeant sheet (black background): idle, football charge, punch, scream, hurt, death, transformation, and the red "roid rage" versions of every attack, plus green/red scream waves. Copied unchanged.
- `neon_sewer_turret_sheet.png` - user-supplied turret sheet; `assets/extract_turret.py` crops the idle turret and small green bolt without changing the source.
- `tacoma_bros_sheet.png` - unchanged supplied RGBA 1774x887 Ludo/Capi sheet. `python assets/extract_tacoma_bros.py` rebuilds isolated, anchored combat poses plus the vehicle idle, five side-drive poses, special-1 charge, two drift/turn views and special-2 donut ring; explicit crops/overlap exclusions and connected-alpha isolation remove labels/neighbors without rotation, recoloring or resampling. Crop, wheel-anchor, canvas-clipping and copied-pixel assertions guard extraction. Character jump, vehicle shooting, beer-rain and hit/explosion art remain unused.
- `tacoma_projectile_sheet.png` - supplied RGB sprite sheet with the Toyota-logo projectile; the Tacoma extractor keys its black background into transparency and emits `assets/tacoma_toyota_projectile.png` without modifying this source.
- `mecha_sheet.png` - unchanged supplied 1536x1024 mecha transformation/moveset illustration, with a painted opaque backdrop rather than a regular transparent grid.

## Pipeline
0. New original Yeral sewer/warehouse art: `node tools/build_yeral_environments.js "<Chrome-or-Edge-executable>"` writes editable SVGs to `art/sheets/generated_yeral/` and rasterized PNGs to `assets/backgrounds/yeral/`. Rasterize using native Chromium with an isolated temporary profile: Godot's SVG renderer omits pattern fills and text. Do not edit or recolor any supplied city/boss paintings. Runtime uses PNGs, not the generated SVG sources.
1. `node tools/slice_sheets.js` - explicit frame boxes (`GROUPS`), keeps the main blob, trims, downscales, and puts every frame of a group on one uniform canvas aligned to the feet. Output `assets/sprites/<group>/<group>_<frame>.png` (`yeral`, `yeral_fx`, `robot`, `robot_fx`).
2. `node tools/slice_lair.js` - labels blobs and assigns them to named `REGIONS`; output `assets/sprites/lair/lair_<name>.png`, trimmed, scaled 0.6.
3. `node tools/slice_gotham.js` - copies the sheet's painted skyline UNALTERED (crop x263,y46 1021x322, right of the title text) to `assets/sprites/city_bg/city_bg_panorama.png` plus a plain `city_bg_sky.png` backstop. Do not recolour, downsample, fade or recompose it - the user wants the original art. Also cuts sprites (colour mask: red >= 26 or bright green; backdrop is low-red smoke; closed, solid-filled for buildings/props, 3x box-downsampled + quantised) into `assets/sprites/gotham/gotham_<tower|roof|bridge|platform|prop|window|ground>_<n>.png`. `node tools/preview_bg.js out.png [scrollX]` composites the background like main.gd.
4. `node tools/contact_sheet.js <group> out.png` - visual check. Write to a new filename each time (image viewers cache).
5. `node tools/gen_assets.js` - generated Yeral tiles/backgrounds/legacy props only. The obsolete red-set `bichema` mode has been removed; stage two uses the supplied scenery instead.
5b. `python assets/extract_bichema.py` - explicit crops/polygons, no recoloring/resampling; normal boss `neon_lawyer_*`, pink-costume boss `ema_costume_*` (512x256 character canvas, feet (256,240); separate pink-bolt cell), and `money_minion_*` (384x256, feet (192,240)) atlases/resources. `python tools/slice_bichema.py` validates the three complete `*_stage.png` paintings and copies them byte-for-byte into `assets/backgrounds/bichema/`, without cropping, resampling or palette fills. `python tools/slice_capital.py [outside-repo-contact.png]` cuts platforms/props into `assets/sprites/capital`; platforms begin on a continuous solid stone row at y=0, with decorative banners below. Source RGBA is retained inside explicit silhouettes. The older `slice_evil_genius.js` remains the source of the lawyer cameo.
6. `python assets/extract_glizzy.py` - rebuilds `assets/glizzy_atlas.png` and `assets/glizzy_frames.tres` from the copied Glizzy source; requires Pillow. Explicit crops, polygon exclusions, and per-pose feet anchors preserve source pixels without neighboring poses.
6b. Current title screen: `assets/ui/title_screen.png` is the supplied `El Señor de la Noche (1).png`, copied byte-for-byte without edits. Preserve its lettering, background and colors. `tools/build_title_screen.py` is the legacy "The Night Unc" generator using `art/sheets/title_screen_original.png`; do not run it against the current title asset, as it would overwrite the replacement.
6c. `python assets/extract_pickups.py` - crops the medalla can and gold coin from the copied sheet into `assets/medalla_can.png` and `assets/coin.png`, without recoloring or resampling.
6d. `node tools/slice_sergeant.js [outside-repo-contact.png]` - explicit boxes over `football_sergeant_sheet.png`; the black background is flood-filled to alpha from each crop border only (dark outlines inside the figure stay intact), tiny detached specks dropped, no recolor/resample. Writes `assets/sergeant_atlas.png` (448x256 cells, feet at (224,244), facing right) and `assets/sergeant_frames.tres` (normal + `rage_*` animations, `wave`/`rage_wave` fx). `jump` reuses the airborne charge stride and `rage_jump` the rage lunge; both are used for leaps and acid escapes.
6e. `python assets/extract_turret.py` - crops the idle turret and small green bolt from the unchanged source sheet into `assets/turret.png` and `assets/turret_bolt.png`.
6f. `python assets/extract_mecha.py [--contact OUTSIDE_REPO.png]` - explicit boxes/contours and alpha-only pigment/background isolation preserve retained source RGB and original resolution. Writes 36 anchored 256x256 poses in `mecha_atlas.png`, all player animations plus `transform`/`revert` in `mecha_frames.tres`, and isolated chest/bolt PNGs. Assertions cover crop bounds, foot anchors, clipping, pixel copies and animation references. Missing actions reuse matching poses; blade sweeps/missile effects are not new gameplay abilities.
6g. The title screen's animated storm is a runtime overlay (`scripts/title_storm.gd`), not a modification to the supplied or generated title image: subtle slanted rain, a light storm tint, and occasional branching lightning with brief screen flashes. It is layered above the title art and below menu controls.
7. Open Godot once so it generates `.import` files; commit them.

When a sheet changes, adjust the boxes/regions in the slicer rather than editing PNGs by hand.

## Godot integration
- Player visibility: `player_outline.gdshader` adds a 1.5-screen-pixel warm-gold outline with a faint 3.5-pixel halo at the normal 0.5 sprite scale, without recoloring source pixels. `Player._update_outline_frame` reads the active SpriteFrames and updates atlas UV bounds on frame/animation changes; clamp the temporary frame index because animation changes can precede frame reset. Mecha form uses the same shader with a bright yellow 2.4px outline at 0.8 scale, and its chest is outlined too. Invulnerability blinking and collision geometry stay unchanged.
- Mecha (`Player.activate_mecha`): 256x256 cells, feet (128,232), scale 0.8, non-centered offset (-128,-232), sprite feet at y=+36. A 20-second chest power-up grants 3-damage gold bolts and temporary dash. Protected transform/revert preserve gravity, pause for external control locks, and restore original art on expiry/death. Existing normal-form abilities remain available. Both routes place a starting and late chest; `tests/mecha_powerup.gd` covers collection/combat/timing/lifecycle.
- `scripts/sprite_lib.gd` (`SpriteLib`): `build(group, anims)` makes `SpriteFrames` from frame suffixes; `make_sprite(frames, feet_y)` places the sprite so the canvas bottom sits at the feet; `texture(group, suffix)`.
- Yeral (`boss_yeral.gd`): body 126x188 (sprite scale 0.5), sprite feet at y=+94, spawn y `FLOOR_Y - 96`. The first health depletion switches to `glizzy_frames.tres`: character canvases 512x384, feet (256,352), scale 0.8, non-centered offset (-256,-352), still at y=+94. Transform and death animations finish before combat resumes or the stage clears; attacks use the sheet's condiment and sauce art.
- Robot minions (`bug.gd`, `robot = true`, Yeral level only): body 44x72, `warn` then `shoot` fires the bolt, `dead` then `boom`, then freed. Dead robots count as cleared for gates.
- Evil Genius / Ema (`boss_evil_genius.gd`): body 120x220, scale 1.5, feet y=+110 in both forms. First depletion starts protected `ema_costume_frames.tres` transform, removes targeting and owned fans/summons/shots, refills difficulty-scaled 72 HP and resets phase 1; combat resumes only after animation completion. Normal-form fan shots use the scaled green cash-bill sprite with a gold outline; the pink costume keeps supplied pink-green bolts and fan/charge/summon semantics with its 1.1x speed/rate multiplier. `transformed` updates the comic caption and boss HUD. Only costume collapse emits final `defeated`; lawyer cameo/dialogue retained then. Own attacks/summons and their shots carry `evil_genius_attacks`.
- Money minions (`truffle_android.gd`, existing `TruffleAndroid` actor API): scale 0.42, body 48x80, atlas feet at collision bottom; warn for 0.5s, then fire the atlas's scaled green cash projectile with a bright gold outline and unchanged hit balance; the shoot pose supplies a gold muzzle flash and hits pop a brief gold `$`; recover from hurt, finish supplied death poses before freeing. Stage-two `WingedMob` uses helicopter `fly` / `fly_warn`, not code-drawn wings.
- Pickups (`pickup.gd`): medalla cans restore up to 4 HP and remain when health is full; coins add 5 points. `tests/pickups.gd` covers healing/full-health preservation/one-time scoring. `Kind.MECHA` uses the supplied outlined chest and consumes only after `Player.activate_mecha()` succeeds; `tests/mecha_powerup.gd` exercises both stages.
- Background: `YeralRoute._build_backdrops` preserves the supplied city panorama's 1.25 scale, bottom alignment, linear filtering and separate skyline-edge feather in Areas 1/5; the legacy `_build_city_background` helper is no longer the active Yeral path. Bichema follows a six-area route with the full 8320 px Yeral length, first five bounds and fades. Four complete room paintings use three unique sources: plaza 2166 px, pub 1805 px, factory 2166 px, then the complete factory repeated as East Wing 2166 px; their natural 8303 px total remains unwarped, with a dark-green backstop covering exposed route edges through the 8320 px route. Uniform scale is `722 / source_height`; complete paintings stay uncut and map-aligned, while narrow source-edge strips fill vertical gaps during camera easing. A 240 px spatial crossfade blends each join while camera framing eases over the same span. Source ground rows `[628,688,533]` align to the world floor. `tests/bichema_background_transition.gd` checks edge coverage and every join.
- Tacoma Bros (`TacomaTruck`): Capi and Ludo stay inside the vehicle; 19 base HP (difficulty-scaled) and one shared health bar. `assets/tacoma_truck_frames.tres` references `assets/tacoma_truck_atlas.png`: ten source poses on common 640x320 canvases, right-facing, wheel/ground anchor (320,240), `AnimatedSprite2D.centered=false`, offset (-320,-240), scale 0.75. Animations: `idle` (one pose), `drive` (five poses at 12 fps), `charge` (special-1 artwork), `drift` (two turn poses at 8 fps), and `spin` (donut/turn/drive viewpoints at 9 fps). Airborne charge art tilts with vertical velocity; grounded charges use `drive`, and recovery cycles the supplied spin views with a facing change. Extra transparent space below y=240 preserves the complete donut dust ring; perspective poses retain their original differing sizes. The right-side intro is non-colliding/undamageable, stops clear of the player, and gives a 1.2s first warning after controls return.
- Platforms/props: all one-way platforms have a static pale-gold 3px landing edge over 7px dark backing with 7px downward end brackets (`main.gd::_add_platform_edge`, group `landing_edges`). Yeral now has deterministic platforms, with exactly three fixed sergeant-room blocks over acid and two moving ascent blocks. Moving-platform markers inherit the body transform. Plaza platforms/bridge and painted pub/factory ledges keep their original collision alignment. Decorative props receive no markers. `tests/platform_visibility.gd` checks coverage/alignment/one-way preservation; `tests/yeral_route.gd` checks actual fixed jumps and moving-block carry/ascent.
- Yeral environments: `YeralRoute` shows supplied city art only in Areas 1/5. Areas 2-4 use `sewer.png`; the final boss room uses `warehouse.png`, with `warehouse_entrance.png` as Area 5's doorway. New generated assets are separate from original art. The warehouse intro uses a cream/black outlined comic speech bubble with a tail pointing toward Yeral and the exact requested introduction line.
- Football Sergeant (`scripts/sergeant.gd`): `AnimatedSprite2D` from `sergeant_frames.tres`, scale 1.0, `centered=false`, offset (-224,-244), flipped when facing left; rage form swaps to the `rage_*` animations. Stun stars over the player are drawn procedurally (`player.gd::_draw_stun`).
- Pixel art uses `TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST` for tiles/props.
- Code-drawn effects (no PNG): first-stage `WingedMob` wings and Yeral's `TrapZone` "Spoiler Pillar" (gold "?" telegraph, lime column, question marks) - keep these in the level palette.
